Name: Gender Neutral Dialogue
Author: conniehedgehog
Description:
This mod makes NPC dialogue completely gender neutral, placing Mr. or Ms. with Mx., using they/them pronouns, etc. This means selecting a gender in the beginning only affects height.

You need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] for this to work.

Known bugs:
The Old Mariner's dialogue is unchanged.
Grandpa in the intro still calls you grandson or granddaughter.

Manifest.Name: Gender Neutral Dialogue
Manifest.Description: Makes NPC dialogue gender netural, changing honourifics, pronouns, and makes gender not affect dialogue at all.
Manifest.Author: Vincent
